distribution.narrative: Liao et al. (2022) provides the first China records of Scolytoplatypus minimus from Sichuan and Yunnan. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Taiwan as catalogue-reported Taiwan distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Direct Chinese specimen evidence from Sichuan Leibo/Mahu was obtained by log dissection from Cinnamomum camphora and is promoted. The source additionally summarizes broader literature hosts across Alnus, Cornus, Prunus, Cinnamomum and Acrocarpus.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus minimus Hagedorn, 1904.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus minimus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The 2022 source uses Scolytoplatypus minimus Hagedorn, 1904, mapping directly to VSN_5424.
